name: Scoring Matrix
author: szaidi-code
description: Local hardware scores with evidence coverage and offline comparisons. Optional scan once per boot; no telemetry.

schema.label: Whole disk to score
schema.description: Leave empty to detect the root disk, or select a whole disk such as /dev/nvme0n1. Applies on the next Rescan.

schema.label: Scan once per boot
schema.description: Scan when the widget starts, reusing a saved snapshot from this boot and disk selection. Takes effect on the next shell start.
